messages:
alex: Pen test report v3 flagged possible key enumeration via our public /v1/keys endpoint — HSM-backed CMKs. Vendor labeled HIGH. They claim an unauthenticated query returns customer key ids. Need triage + immediate retest request.
sanjay: Can you paste repro steps / curl they used?
alex: PoC they sent (vendor):
```
curl -v 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys?prefix=cust-123'
```
They also claim it worked without Authorization: header:
```
curl -v 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys?prefix=cust-123'
```
Notes: response contained masked key ids but real prefix and count.
dina: Which internal route does that map to? kms-proxy, admin API, or control-plane? Need audit logs + HSM events for that window (timestamp in report: 2026-03-02T14:20Z - 2026-03-03T02:00Z).
alex: It hits kms-proxy via public /v1/keys -> internal /internal/kms/list-keys. I pulled a short log snippet showing a 200 on anonymous requests around 2026-03-02T14:22Z: https://internal.redwood/pen-tests/1766123456/kms-log-snippet.txt
maria: I pushed a change last week to require mTLS from control-plane to kms-proxy. Could a config rollback have re-opened the path? I'll check deploy history now.
sanjay: Assigning myself to reproduce on staging. Any special headers/tokens? alex: Vendor said none required; they ran plain curl and observed JSON with key ids.
secops-bot: Created ticket SEC-2345: https://jira.redwoodai.com/browse/SEC-2345 (triage + evidence collection). Severity currently HIGH per pen-test vendor.
maria: Found likely root cause: routing rule change during 2026-03-01 deploy removed the `require_auth` check for that path. PR ready to re-add auth check: PR #4021. Can do hotfix to canary now.
dina: I'll need HSM audit exports for 2026-03-01 -> 2026-03-03 and KMS proxy logs. Infra, please attach the KMS audit bundle to SEC-2345.
sanjay: Reproduced on staging: anonymous curl -> 403 on staging (good). Need approval to test prod canary domain for repro. Requesting brief maintenance window for safe probe.
alex: Vendor also claims they enumerated multiple customer prefixes during ~36h window — that's the compliance exposure. We should consider customer notification if that proves true.
maria: Hotfix rolling to canary now. Will post retest evidence link when up. PR includes mTLS enforcement + extra unit tests for path gating.
(~45m later)
maria: Canary up. Retest: anonymous curl now returns 401. Evidence: https://internal.redwood/pen-tests/1766123456/retest-curl-output.txt
sanjay: Verified in prod logs: post-deploy anonymous requests return 401 and KMS proxy did not generate list-keys events after fix. I attached logs to SEC-2345.
alex: Do we maintain HIGH severity? Pen tester argues access existed for ~36h and they enumerated prefixes.
dina: Impact assessment: exposure revealed key prefixes (metadata) but not raw key material. Cross-customer information disclosure is serious for compliance (GDPR/PCI/enterprise contracts). Recommend MEDIUM and full customer impact check. Also require external retest.
maria: Agree. Changing SEC-2345 to MEDIUM. Scheduling vendor retest in 72h to validate fix.
secops-bot: SEC-2345 severity set to MEDIUM by Dina. External retest scheduled for 2026-03-05 17:00Z.
alex: Thanks. Next actions: postmortem draft (timeline + root cause), ensure mTLS + gating unit tests merged, validate HSM audit integrity, and prepare customer-notify draft if any customer prefixes were enumerated. Owners: Maria (code/fix), Dina (audit & compliance), Sanjay (retest & evidence).
maria: ok :thumbsup:
sanjay: on it
dina: will draft notice and compliance assessment
